titleEn: Create and submit a template to Meta (own WABA)
planGate: package in good standing + active number

ar: عايز اعمل رسالة بلغ بيها العميل إن الأوردر اتشحن
en: How do I create a message template?
Write me a template that tells the customer their order shipped

steps: Today: raw API only (name [a-z0-9_], language, category MARKETING/UTILITY/AUTHENTICATION, BODY required)
Planned: Templates screen + assistant template-writer (spec section 6.7)
edgeCases: Meta may require example values for variables; our schema is permissive so Meta may reject (unverified)
Rejections: wrong category, vague text, prohibited content, variable formatting, promotional content in UTILITY
Meta can recategorise UTILITY to MARKETING (category-update webhook re-checks held sends)
Name reuse: rejected name needs a new name (no edit API)
Quality rating of a template can drop to low and pause it (not tracked in our DB)
Template limits per WABA (250/6000 by verification) not surfaced
Meta unreachable or rate-limited: 503 rate_limited, retry shortly; nothing is lost
No active package: sends, agent and number connect answer 403 plan_required (no free plan, WA-NOFREE-1); a past_due package keeps replies/confirmations up to 7 days
On the shared platform number: marketing templates are refused, templates come from the platform catalogue, wallet pays Meta
assistantNote: a submission to Meta on the merchant account; cannot be withdrawn, edit not supported by our API
